body.name: Strict utility-comparison graph
body.construction: For each context \((t,h)\), designated winner \(d\), and loser \(c\in M_t\setminus\{d\}\), place in \(G_{\kappa,f}\) the difference constraint \(z_c-z_d<p_{tc}-p_{td}+\kappa(\mathbf 1\{d=h\}-\mathbf 1\{c=h\})\); use \(h=h_0,d=f_1\) at \(t=1\), and \(h=a,d=f_2(a)\) for every \(a\in M_1\) at \(t=2\).
